description: This file defines the MacNodeLocationService class, which manages location services using CoreLocation. It provides asynchronous methods to obtain the current location with timeout handling and manages CLLocationManager delegate callbacks.

classes.name: MacNodeLocationService
classes.description: A final class that manages location updates asynchronously, conforming to CLLocationManagerDelegate and providing location services within Swift concurrency context.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current location with specified accuracy, maximum age, and timeout constraints.

methods.name: withTimeout
methods.description: Wraps an asynchronous operation with a timeout, cancelling the operation if it exceeds the specified milliseconds.
